steps.title: Attestation passes consistently (3 consecutive runs)
steps.accept: tools/attest.py prints VERDICT: ATTESTED three times in a row - and each run must include the DOSE-RESPONSE check (holding D 3x longer must move the fighter ~3x further). The direction gate alone can be satisfied by the title screen's attract demo by coincidence; proportionality cannot. All runs appended to state/attest_runs.log.

steps.title: Observe a real round transition in memory
steps.accept: game.rounds() reports the same transition kind twice, with the room change or teleport logged in state/rounds.jsonl

steps.title: Wire the verified round signal into the reward
steps.accept: train_win.py pays a round term only when the observed transition fires; a claim.py entry proves the term changed a fitness value

steps.title: Run 3 full generations without restarting the trainer
steps.accept: three '== gen N best' lines in one run log, with per-generation claim rows

steps.title: Establish whether any policy beats another at >=2 sigma
steps.accept: summarize.py output showing a >=2 sigma gap, recorded as a claim with its command

steps.title: Win a round against the CPU, verified
steps.accept: a round transition with us as the winner, corroborated by two independent signals

steps.title: Measure a win rate over >=10 verified rounds
steps.accept: evaluate.py over >=10 rounds, recorded as a claim

steps.title: WSP-style weight analysis + hand-edited policy comparison
steps.accept: layer dump, reasoning, hand-edited variant scored head-to-head

steps.title: Human-vs-agent demo
steps.accept: play_vs_agent.sh run with the trained policy, outcome recorded

steps.title: Verify the observation is physically meaningful in every arena
steps.accept: obs_vector recorded from three different rooms; every component inside [-1,1] except y/600 which must stay in [0,1]; no feature may depend on a per-room constant. Recorded via tools/claim.py.

steps.title: Decide the reward question with numbers, not taste
steps.accept: the fitness has a measurable gradient: >=2 sigma separation between a scripted pusher and an idle policy at the current reps, recorded as a claim with its command.

steps.title: Scale to N parallel game instances once 01-04 are green
steps.accept: N>=2 instances running via InstanceManager(iid=i), aggregate throughput measured and claimed; only start this after attestation, round signal and 3 generations have passed.

steps.title: Generalize across ARENAS, not one room
steps.accept: matches recorded in >=3 distinct arena groups (castle 26-33, mines 43-52, sky 53-60, wilds 61-68, cemetery 70-77), with per-arena-group fitness reported. The room index is already published, so this is bookkeeping plus enough episodes.

steps.title: Curriculum: vary the TRAINING partner type
steps.accept: the partner list is reachable by keys (NO DIVEKICKS / NO THROWS / DIVEKICKER / RUN N LUNGE / BRAWLER / NEVER LUNGES / PARRY MASTER / RANDOM); a policy is trained against a rotating partner and its fitness is reported per partner, so it cannot overfit one opponent.

steps.title: Difficulty sweep: train low, evaluate high
steps.accept: the TRAINING submenu exposes a DIFFICULTY slider (A/D adjusts). Train at the low end, evaluate at low/medium/high, and record the win rate at each - a policy that only wins at the setting it trained on has not generalized.
